subject: At the time of voting..
author: ZombieTron
body:
I was being cheap, I have since purchased the Hot Rod, still think it is a lot of money for 1 car, but it is a good addition to the game.

I think a lot of people have been put off by the pricing of the DLC, it is a lot of money to shell out for just a few extra cars in the game.
